pages.text: If you use a spirit tablet on a shrine, it will become linked to that shrine. If then placed in a diagram, it will allow the diagram to interface with the linked shrine for bindings and transfusions.$(br2)As the tablet becomes further than 16 blocks from the shrine, its efficiency falters, with 50% at 555 blocks.

If the tablet is very far or in another dimension, efficiency gets as low as 10%.$(br2)This multiplier affects the number of spirits transferred in either direction, as well as binding influence.$(br2)Spirit tablets can be un-linked in a grindstone.
